sections.title: Impostazioni del modello di richiesta
paragraphs: Use this form when requesting quick quotes from multiple suppliers for non-catalog items. If the product you are seeking is available through product search, please purchase it there from one of the approved vendors. &nbsp;Otherwise, specify the item(s) using this form, select the suppliers, and submit for approval and distribution to suppliers. They will be asked to submit a quote to you directly, and you will enter the information here.&nbsp;
